definitions.explanation: Fitting or right for a particular situation, purpose, or person.

examples.japanese: {適切|てきせつ}な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{適切|てきせつ}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いします→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{適切|てきせつ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What is appropriate in this case?

notes:
{適切|てきせつ} is a na-adjective meaning appropriate or suitable.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {適切|てきせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (appropriately)
- Noun modifier: {適切|てきせつ}な + noun

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {適切|てきせつ}な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ (appropriate judgment)
- {適切|てきせつ}な⟦{処置|しょち}→処置：05823_shochi⟧ (appropriate measures)
- {適切|てきせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (respond appropriately)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{適当|てきとう}→適当：01674_tekitou⟧: suitable; random/half-hearted (careful: has two meanings!)
- {適切|てきせつ}: appropriate (always positive)
- ⟦ふさわしい→相応しい：10476_fusawashii⟧: befitting, suitable
